name: plm-website
description: Build tooling for precisionlasermark.com — minifies the site's JS/CSS for production so the deployed source is harder to casually read/copy. The plain files (script.js, styles.css, card-editor.js, card-editor.css, etc.) stay the ones you actually edit; run `npm run build` to regenerate the .min.js/.min.css siblings right before deploying.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: esbuild script.js card-editor.js card-types/card-types-data.js templates/templates-data.js fonts/fonts-data.js --minify --outdir=. --out-extension:.js=.min.js --allow-overwrite
